mapper.select: SELECT asset_id, project_id, name, asset_type, role FROM asset WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY asset_id
SELECT i.ip_id, i.asset_id, i.address, i.ip_type, i.phase, i.ext_whitelisted FROM asset_ip i JOIN asset a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id WHERE a.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY i.ip_id
SELECT dependency_id, project_id, from_asset_id, to_asset_id, target_address, target_port, protocol, config_location FROM dependency WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY dependency_id
SELECT dns_id, project_id, domain, record_type, value, ttl, phase FROM dns_record WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY dns_id
SELECT cert_id, project_id, domain, issuer, not_after, phase FROM certificate WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY cert_id

SELECT s.software_id, s.asset_id, s.product, s.role, s.version, s.release_line, s.phase FROM asset_software s JOIN asset a ON a.asset_id = s.asset_id WHERE a.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY s.software_id

SELECT b.backup_id, b.asset_id, b.last_backup_at, b.restore_tested, b.offsite, b.phase FROM backup_plan b JOIN asset a ON a.asset_id = b.asset_id WHERE a.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY b.backup_id

SELECT r.rule_id, r.rule_code, f.code AS factor_code, f.name AS factor_name, f.weight AS factor_weight, r.title, r.severity, r.occurrence, r.detection, r.is_blocking AS blocking, r.message_template, r.mitigation FROM risk_rule r JOIN risk_factor f ON f.factor_id = r.factor_id WHERE r.enabled = 1

SELECT r.run_id AS runId, r.executed_at AS executedAt, r.risk_level AS riskLevel, r.blocked AS blocked, r.finding_count AS findingCount, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(f.rpn) FROM diagnosis_finding f WHERE f.run_id = r.run_id), 0) AS maxRpn, r.total_score AS totalScore FROM diagnosis_run r WHERE r.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY r.executed_at DESC, r.run_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.run_id AS runId, r.executed_at AS executedAt, r.risk_level AS riskLevel, r.blocked AS blocked, r.finding_count AS findingCount, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(f.rpn) FROM diagnosis_finding f WHERE f.run_id = r.run_id), 0) AS maxRpn, r.total_score AS totalScore FROM diagnosis_run r WHERE r.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY r.executed_at ASC, r.run_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diagnosis_run (project_id, total_score, risk_level, blocked, finding_count) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{totalScore}, #{riskLevel}, #{blocked}, #{findingCount})

INSERT INTO diagnosis_finding (run_id, rule_id, asset_id, dependency_id, rpn, detail) VALUES
(#{f.runId}, #{f.ruleId}, #{f.assetId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{f.dependencyId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{f.rpn}, #{f.detail})
